items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: I liked Charles Lloyd with Chico Hamilton. There is a series of great Chico Hamilton records.

ctx.x: That was one of them okay. He handed me that in mono, and the other one you won’t guess but it’s an album that rearranged my DNA for the rest of my life and it remains rearranged to this point, and that was Chico Hamilton “Man from Two Worlds” on Impulse, musical director Charles Lloyd.
Ah. I was going to guess Charles Lloyd as the second one so I was close.
